title: ericameria parryi var. aspera
intro: Ericameria parryi var. aspera, commonly known as Parry's goldenrod, is a plant species that belongs to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly by Native American communities, for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and acting as a natural antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Parry's goldenrod include its ability to soothe skin irritations, wound healing, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may also help with respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
